title: Knicks vs. Spurs Post-Game Stats: Jalen Brunson Delivers as NY Takes Control of NBA Finals Battle - NewsBreak
text:
By Shabiha Akter ,
1 hours ago
Jalen Brunson and Victor Wembanyama (Photo By Imagn Images) The New York Knicks have reached the NBA Finals after 27 years. After winning this season’s NBA Cup , Jalen Brunson’s team now chases a long-awaited championship. The New York side opened the Finals with a 105–95 victory over the San Antonio Spurs at the Frost Bank Center.
Once again, Brunson led the charge as the Knicks secured the win. The game shifted late in the third quarter when New York tightened its defense, and its frontcourt players sparked a strong run. From there, the Knicks controlled the closing minutes and pulled away comfortably to take a double-digit road win and a 1–0 series lead.
Jalen Brunson Unleashes Finals Masterclass as Knicks Take Game 1 Statement Win vs. Spurs The Spurs mocked the Knicks during player introductions with cartoon music, but Brunson and his team responded decisively on the court. In his first NBA Finals appearance, Brunson finished with 30 points, three rebounds, and two assists. He also delivered 13 points in the fourth quarter alone to close out the win.
Brunson now holds the second-most 30-point playoff games by a point guard in NBA history. He has surpassed Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and now sits tied with Luka Doncic in 30-point playoff performances.
Karl-Anthony Towns recorded a double-double with 18 points and 12 rebounds to support the Knicks’ victory. OG Anunoby added 17 points, while Landry Shamet contributed 13 points off the bench.
For San Antonio, Victor Wembanyama, who wants four more wins this season , led the team with 26 points, 12 rebounds, two assists, and three blocks. However, New York’s physical defense disrupted his rhythm, limiting him to 2-of-9 from three-point range and 6-of-21 from the field.
Stephon Castle added 17 points and eight rebounds, while Julian Champagnie contributed 16 points. Rookie Dylan Harper provided strong energy off the bench with 16 efficient points and led the team in scoring. De’Aaron Fox finished with seven points in the loss.
